title: 《天空之城》（连续高潮选段）
hint: 连续高潮选段：从后半主题弱起至原谱收尾，55个单音、65拍，原谱88 BPM，1倍速约44秒。不含“6、7、1”开头；21音C调无需调音，无拼接、无改音，不是全曲。

unsupported: Selected one continuous source range [67,132): the C5-D5 pickup at the last beat of measure 17 through the printed final A4 of measure 33. The preceding opening theme is omitted as a whole; there are no internal editorial joins.

The complete theme contains F-sharp and G-sharp unavailable on the fixed natural-note instrument. The selected melody itself needs neither pitch; no accidental is replaced, and no local octave folding is used.
V1 omits all lower accompaniment and the simultaneous lower B4 under the source-identified D5 melody at measure 19.

The one-beat pickup starts at output beat 0. The app provides preparation before playback; no extra score rests are inserted. Printed 88 BPM is retained: 65 quarter beats take 44.318 seconds, excluding preparation and player tail.
This is the chosen 2018 MV arrangement, whose later repeated attacks differ from some other editions. It is not a claim to reproduce every articulation of the original recording.

reviewRequired: Reference-recording listening and physical 21-key kalimba play-through were not performed; source pixels and independent transcription were checked separately.

focusedReview.identityMatch: The single-line 1=C, 4/4 theme score matches the current opening, repeated opening and cadence; its ties and some rhythms differ from the current data.

sameBarAccidentalScope.reason: The next degree 4 in the same printed bar has no natural sign. Check accidental carry-through against the chosen 2019 arrangement; do not assume F-natural.

focusedReview.measureNumbering: Current app numbering includes the initial pickup/rest bar as measure 1; step indices are zero-based.
focusedReview.fitReason: All 12 consistent semitone transpositions were checked. Nine distinct melody pitch classes cannot fit the fixed instrument's seven natural pitch classes; octave shifts cannot remove this constraint.
focusedReview.originalArrangementStatus: The 2019 Qupu123 source page is readable, but its score image was unavailable: web fetches returned Cache miss/not accessible and ordinary direct public-image requests returned HTTP 502. The full 24-bar arrangement, accompaniment and measure 15 ties were not revalidated.
focusedReview.changeScope: Display labels and review metadata only. All 79 melody tuples, timing, tempo and the historical chord source are unchanged.
